signup.title: Signup
signup.approval_required: A company that signs up waits for approval

demo.title: Demo
demo.intro: A visitor tries the app in a demonstration company of their own, with no account, erased when they sign out or stop using it. No mail leaves and no document has fiscal value.

coming.title: What is coming
coming.intro: The modules and actions not built yet, marked “Soon” in the menus and pages. Hidden until someone shows them: this choice holds for the whole installation, and each company, then each person, may change it for themselves.

imports.title: Imports
imports.intro: How many rows one imported file may hold, header excluded. A file is imported in one piece, all or nothing; a longer file is refused, and the person splits it into several.

waiting.title: Waiting for approval
waiting.none: No company is waiting for approval.

companies.title: Companies
companies.name: Company name
companies.owner_invitation_open: Owner invitation sent to {{email}}, valid until {{day}}.
companies.owner_invitation_expired: The owner invitation sent to {{email}} ran out on {{day}}: invite again.

actions.label: Company actions
actions.approve_message: {{name}} opens to its members, and its owners are told by mail. “Suspend” closes it again.
actions.restore_message: {{name}} opens to its members again, and its owners are told by mail. “Suspend” closes it again.
actions.reject_message: {{name}} stays closed to its members. “Restore access” opens it later.
actions.suspend_message: The members of {{name}} lose access to it, from now on. Its data stays intact, and “Restore access” reopens it.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.end_sessions_message: {{name}} is signed out on every device and must sign in again. An ended session does not come back.
accounts.deactivate_message: {{name}} can no longer sign in, and every one of their sessions ends. “Reactivate” gives the access back.

errors.own_account: You cannot deactivate your own account.
errors.network: The server could not be reached.
errors.name_taken: A company already has that name.
errors.already_member: That address already belongs to this company.
errors.step_up_required: Nothing changed: confirm it is you to make this change.
errors.invalid: Nothing was saved: correct the fields marked.

subscription.stop: Stop managing and erase the terms
subscription.stopped: {{name}} is no longer managed: its terms are erased and it has full access.
subscription.stop_message: The terms of {{name}} (period, trial, paid through, price, delays) are erased, and nothing keeps them: its members get full access again. To manage it again, its terms must be typed anew.

payments.title: Payments to confirm
payments.confirm_message: The payment of {{name}} extends its subscription by the number of periods given: {{periods}}. A wrong count is corrected in its terms.
payments.reject_message: The wait this payment held for {{name}} ends at once: if its paid period is over, its access follows its terms. It can declare another payment.

demand.title: Modules awaited
demand.intro: How many companies asked to be told when each module arrives.
demand.empty: No company is waiting for a module yet.

legal.title: Legal pages
legal.intro: Every page, in every language, as anyone reads it. A new version is published at once and marked a draft until it is validated.
legal.waiting: {{count}} {count, plural, one {text to validate} other {texts to validate}}
legal.published: New version published, marked a draft.
legal.failed: The legal pages cannot be read right now.

identity.title: Publisher and host
identity.intro: What the legal pages name, where a text writes its mark in double braces. What is not filled in shows « [to be completed] ».

host.name: Host
host.country: Country where the data is hosted

failed.title: Messages not sent
failed.total: {{count}} {count, plural, one {message was not sent after its retries} other {messages were not sent after their retries}}.
failed.retry: They wait on the server. Once the cause is fixed, send them again from the worker service:

delays.title: Delays
delays.intro: The days the platform leaves every company and every account before a change takes effect.

support.title: Support contact
support.intro: What every screen’s help offers everyone signed in under “Contact us”. A channel left empty is not shown.
support.whatsapp_hint: The number in international form, country code first: +216 20 123 456
support.status_url_hint: Linked from the foot of every page, for example https://status.example.com

texts.title: Installation texts
texts.intro: The application's words, on the screens, in the mails and on the printed documents, as every company reads them. Each one can still replace them with its own.

grants.title: Support access
grants.intro: The companies whose owner lets support read them, read-only, until the time shown.
grants.none: No company has opened its access to support for now.
